//: Theo storage sync for Claude Code — pull your shared .claude/ on session start, push edits on session end. Merge these hooks into your project's .claude/settings.json (or ~/.claude/settings.json for all projects). Requires `theo login` + a key with storage:read/write. The --exclude flags are a SAFETY FENCE: hooks/ and settings*.json are executable config; a pull must NEVER overwrite the code the agent runs (see README.md § Safety). Sync ships inert config (skills, memory, CLAUDE.md, docs) — executing synced hooks/skills is gated on the trust model (not yet shipped).
